export const cropRegion = { row: 12, column: 14, rows: 4, columns: 4 }
const channels = ['red', 'green', 'blue'] as const
const channelLabels = ['R · red', 'G · green', 'B · blue']

/** All labels, image colors and moving values share this same original sample. */
export function imageTensorFrame(theme: ThemeMode, cursor = 15.999, reveal = 1, animate = false) {
    const c = getThemeColors(theme)
    const step = Math.min(15, Math.max(0, Math.floor(cursor)))
    const row = Math.floor(step / 4), col = step % 4
    const activeCell = { row: cropRegion.row + row, column: cropRegion.column + col }
    const pixel = cifar10Pixels[activeCell.row][activeCell.column]
    const crop = cropRgbImage(cifar10Pixels, cropRegion)
    const travel = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (cursor - Math.floor(cursor)) / .85))
    const arrival = !animate || travel >= .98
    const channelColor = theme === 'dark'
        ? [c.criticalLight, c.positiveLight, c.infoLight]
        : [c.criticalDark, c.positiveDark, c.infoDark]
    const originX = 64 + (activeCell.column + .5) * 10
    const originY = 217 + (activeCell.row + .5) * 10
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'relative', width, height, backgroundColor: c.bg, color: c.textPrimary, fontFamily: c.fontSans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 34, color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 13, letterSpacing: 2 }}>COMPUTER VISION / IMAGE → TENSOR</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 65, fontSize: 44, fontWeight: 750, letterSpacing: -1.4 }}>One picture. Three matrices.</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 127, fontSize: 19, color: c.textSecondary }}>Read one pixel, then copy its red, green and blue bytes into three channel matrices.</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 180, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700 }}>Actual CIFAR-10 image · frog</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 217 }}>
                <PixelGrid c={c} pixels={cifar10Pixels} width={320} height={320} region={cropRegion} activeCell={activeCell} highlightColor={c.warning} />
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 555, width: 330, flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                <span style={{ color: c.textPrimary, fontSize: 21, fontFamily: c.fontMono }}>pixel[{activeCell.row}, {activeCell.column}]</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 25, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontWeight: 700 }}>[{pixel.join(', ')}]</span>
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 16 }}>32 × 32 × 3 = 3,072 byte values</span>
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 15 }}>Crop: rows 12–15 · cols 14–17</span>
            </div>
            {channels.map((channel, index) => {
                const x = 430 + index * 274
                const values = rgbChannel(crop, channel)
                const labels = values.map((r, ri) => r.map((v, ci) => !animate || ri * 4 + ci < step || ri * 4 + ci === step && arrival ? String(v) : '·'))
                const alpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (reveal - index * .14) / .6))
                return <div key={channel} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: x, top: 177, width: 250, height: 470, opacity: alpha }}>
                    <span style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, width: 250, justifyContent: 'center', color: channelColor[index], fontSize: 21, fontWeight: 700 }}>{channelLabels[index]} · 32 × 32</span>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 45, top: 40 }}><PixelGrid c={c} pixels={cifar10Pixels} width={160} height={160} channel={channel} region={cropRegion} activeCell={activeCell} highlightColor={c.warning} /></div>
                    <span style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 435, width: 250, justifyContent: 'center', color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 14 }}>The same 4 × 4 crop · values 0–255</span>
                    {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => <span key={'col' + i} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 36 + i * 45, top: 233, width: 43, height: 20, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>{14 + i}</span>)}
                    {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => <span key={'row' + i} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 4, top: 253 + i * 44, width: 28, height: 42, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>{12 + i}</span>)}
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 36, top: 253 }}><Matrix c={c} data={values} labels={labels} colorize={false} format="integer" fontSize={20} cellWidth={43} cellHeight={42} highlightCell={{ row, col }} highlightColor={channelColor[index]} /></div>
                </div>
            })}

export const cropRegion = { row: 12, column: 14, rows: 4, columns: 4 }
const channels = ['red', 'green', 'blue'] as const
const channelLabels = ['R · red', 'G · green', 'B · blue']

/** All labels, image colors and moving values share this same original sample. */
export function imageTensorFrame(theme: ThemeMode, cursor = 15.999, reveal = 1, animate = false) {
    const c = getThemeColors(theme)
    const step = Math.min(15, Math.max(0, Math.floor(cursor)))
    const row = Math.floor(step / 4), col = step % 4
    const activeCell = { row: cropRegion.row + row, column: cropRegion.column + col }
    const pixel = cifar10Pixels[activeCell.row][activeCell.column]
    const crop = cropRgbImage(cifar10Pixels, cropRegion)
    const travel = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (cursor - Math.floor(cursor)) / .85))
    const arrival = !animate || travel >= .98
    const channelColor = theme === 'dark'
        ? [c.criticalLight, c.positiveLight, c.infoLight]
        : [c.criticalDark, c.positiveDark, c.infoDark]
    const originX = 64 + (activeCell.column + .5) * 10
    const originY = 217 + (activeCell.row + .5) * 10
    return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'relative', width, height, backgroundColor: c.bg, color: c.textPrimary, fontFamily: c.fontSans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 34, color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 13, letterSpacing: 2 }}>COMPUTER VISION / IMAGE → TENSOR</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 65, fontSize: 44, fontWeight: 750, letterSpacing: -1.4 }}>One picture. Three matrices.</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 127, fontSize: 19, color: c.textSecondary }}>Read one pixel, then copy its red, green and blue bytes into three channel matrices.</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 180, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700 }}>Actual CIFAR-10 image · frog</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 217 }}>
                <PixelGrid c={c} pixels={cifar10Pixels} width={320} height={320} region={cropRegion} activeCell={activeCell} highlightColor={c.warning} />
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 555, width: 330, flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                <span style={{ color: c.textPrimary, fontSize: 21, fontFamily: c.fontMono }}>pixel[{activeCell.row}, {activeCell.column}]</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 25, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontWeight: 700 }}>[{pixel.join(', ')}]</span>
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 16 }}>32 × 32 × 3 = 3,072 byte values</span>
                <span style={{ color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 15 }}>Crop: rows 12–15 · cols 14–17</span>
            </div>
            {channels.map((channel, index) => {
                const x = 430 + index * 274
                const values = rgbChannel(crop, channel)
                const labels = values.map((r, ri) => r.map((v, ci) => !animate || ri * 4 + ci < step || ri * 4 + ci === step && arrival ? String(v) : '·'))
                const alpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (reveal - index * .14) / .6))
                return <div key={channel} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: x, top: 177, width: 250, height: 470, opacity: alpha }}>
                    <span style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, width: 250, justifyContent: 'center', color: channelColor[index], fontSize: 21, fontWeight: 700 }}>{channelLabels[index]} · 32 × 32</span>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 45, top: 40 }}><PixelGrid c={c} pixels={cifar10Pixels} width={160} height={160} channel={channel} region={cropRegion} activeCell={activeCell} highlightColor={c.warning} /></div>
                    <span style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 435, width: 250, justifyContent: 'center', color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 14 }}>The same 4 × 4 crop · values 0–255</span>
                    {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => <span key={'col' + i} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 36 + i * 45, top: 233, width: 43, height: 20, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>{14 + i}</span>)}
                    {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => <span key={'row' + i} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 4, top: 253 + i * 44, width: 28, height: 42, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: c.textSecondary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 14 }}>{12 + i}</span>)}
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 36, top: 253 }}><Matrix c={c} data={values} labels={labels} colorize={false} format="integer" fontSize={20} cellWidth={43} cellHeight={42} highlightCell={{ row, col }} highlightColor={channelColor[index]} /></div>
                </div>
            })}
            {animate && reveal >= .99 && travel > .02 && travel < .98 && channels.map((channel, index) => {
                const targetX = 430 + index * 274 + 36 + 21.5 + col * 45
                const targetY = 430 + 21 + row * 44
                const x = originX + (targetX - originX) * travel
                const y = originY + (targetY - originY) * travel - Math.sin(Math.PI * travel) * 45
                return <div key={channel} style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: x - 22, top: y - 17, width: 44, height: 34, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 6, backgroundColor: c.bgCard, border: '2px solid ' + channelColor[index], color: c.textPrimary, fontFamily: c.fontMono, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 700 }}>{pixel[index]}</div>
            })}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', position: 'absolute', left: 64, top: 684, color: c.textSecondary, fontSize: 13 }}>Source: CIFAR-10 · Krizhevsky (2009) · training batch 1, record 0 · original channel-first bytes [3, 32, 32]</div>
        </div>
    )
}

export function create(theme: ThemeMode = 'dark') { return imageTensorFrame(theme) }
export default create('dark')
